purpose: Test whether a promoted assignment can remain reversibly probationary so delayed contradictory evidence can safely trigger rollback without deleting prior evidence or accepting stale completions.
mechanism_placeholder: probationary two-phase authority transfer with authority epochs
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local assignment-switch controller trace only; no claim about distributed systems, production deployments, or optimizer superiority.
promotion_rule: After independent same-scope terminal qualification of B, transfer current authority to B as PROBATIONARY at epoch 11 while preserving A and all prior evidence immutably as rollback fallback. Promotion is not irreversible finalization.

probation_window.counted_event: unique same-scope terminal contradiction against current probationary B
non_counting: completion carrying an authority epoch other than the current epoch

rollback_rule: During probation, two unique same-scope terminal contradictions against B within the three-observation window qualify rollback only if A is still scope-valid. Rollback transfers authority to A at a fresh epoch and retains B evidence as immutable history rather than deleting it.
fallback_invalid_rule: If A is no longer scope-valid, do not roll back to A; quarantine B for requalification and open an unresolved re-selection child instead.
stale_completion_rule: Any promotion, qualification, or completion carrying an authority epoch different from the current authority epoch is stale and must not mutate authority.

bounded_trace.event: unique same-scope terminal contradiction C1 against B at epoch 11
unique same-scope terminal contradiction C2 against B at epoch 11
bounded_trace.expected: rollback qualifies; authority=A at fresh epoch 12

bounded_trace.event: late B promotion completion carrying epoch 11
bounded_trace.expected: reject stale completion; authority remains A epoch 12

guards.G2: promotion explicitly enters probation rather than irreversible final state
guards.G3: probation window is bounded before source audit
guards.G4: only same-scope terminal evidence can qualify rollback
guards.G5: contradictions are deduplicated by durable evidence identity
guards.G6: transport/tool failure is not semantic contradiction
guards.G7: rollback threshold is precommitted before public mechanism audit
guards.G8: rollback target A must still be scope-valid
guards.G10: old-epoch completions cannot mutate authority after rollback
guards.G11: terminal artifact must be durably sealed and read back before any credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer-mode/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 all hold on the fixed trace after public-source mechanism binding; otherwise FAIL. No post-source rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit itself earns zero credit. At most one new role-local credit may be considered only after terminal artifact seal plus independent readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting assignment-switch/recovery failure mode and precommit it before reading new public mechanism semantics.
